one_line: Show the finished result first, then every step in one static take with a subtitle that changes each second.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 profile: a woman with a baby on her back in a finished wrap carry glances back. Pink sticker "DH DR BASE -3". 0:03 cut to a front shot, she holds the open wrap; first subtitle word "אז".
q1_hook.why: The finished carry and a face glancing back give motion and a person at once (H1, H4, E1). But the first text is code in Latin letters that only wrap users decode, and no subtitle states the promise until "אז" at 0:03 (H2, T3 not met).

beats.what: Profile of the finished back carry, she glances back; sticker "DH DR BASE -3"
beats.why: The result first, with a person in frame

beats.what: Front shot: she holds the wrap open, lifts the baby onto her back, bites the edge; "לכבוד", "דאבל"
beats.why: Names the tie; the biting adds a funny moment

beats.what: Back view: she builds a deep pocket and tightens it, one word at a time on screen
beats.why: First step shown live with the baby

beats.what: Side and back views: the long tail passes under the arm, the second pocket is tightened
beats.why: Second step, new angles each few seconds

beats.what: Front: she takes two gold rings and threads the wrap end through; "לוקחת", "משחילה"
beats.why: The ring finish, the hardest part, filmed close
The finished tie shown from the front
A seasonal sign-off with personality, no new information

beats.what: She dances and talks, baby on her back, no subtitles
beats.why: A relaxed ending, nothing new to learn

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "שומרות ומנסות???" (saving and trying?) and an invitation to a session in Herzliya on 5.10. Nothing in the video asks for a comment, save or share.
q2_flow.why: Result first, then one long step-by-step take where the view changes as she turns (R3, F8), with a funny moment, biting the wrap, adding personality inside the information (K4). But 64 s of word-by-word text for one tie is long, and about 9 s of black follows the end (R1, R2, E8).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: no spoken or on-screen ask, only a greeting at 0:54 to 0:57 ("השבת חג ושבת שלום"). Caption: "שומרות ומנסות???" and an invitation, "נחכה לכן בהרצליה ב5.10", with a tag @michelletheblondie.
q3_cta.why: The asks sit only in the caption: save and try, then come to a session in Herzliya, two different actions (C1). Saving suits a how-to (R7, C4), but nothing is said or shown in the video, and the invitation has no sign-up step (C6).

q4_shown.what: A pastel tie-dye wrap with two gold rings tied step by step on her body with a baby on her back (0:03 to 0:53). The finished carry at 0:00 and from 0:49 to 1:04. No price or brand.
q4_shown.why: The wrap is in use from the first frame and every step is done live, so the proof is the finished carry itself (S1, S6). A face is shown because she talks (S4). A baby's face is on screen throughout, which LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: Takes of about 6 to 20 s (about 9 cuts in the first pass), mostly a static camera, straight cuts. One-word subtitles change about every second from 0:03 to 0:57, none after. Sticker 0:00 to 0:02. About 9 s of black at the end.
q5_edit.why: One-word subtitles keep something changing over long takes (E4), and the steady camera lets the steps be followed (R3). But 74 s for one tie is long, and the content ends at 1:04 yet the file is not cut (R1, R2, E8).

q6_topic.what: A pre-Shabbat tutorial for a back carry with a ring wrap (double hammock double ring). Serves parents who babywear and want to learn a tie.
q6_topic.why: A practical skill that babywearing parents want, wrapped in humour and personality (K4, K6). It is a Reel to save and try again (R7), as the caption asks. The jargon ("DH DR", "בסיס שלוש") narrows it to people who already wear wraps.

q7_filmed.what: Mostly a static phone in a bedroom, soft light; she turns to show front, side and back. Handheld for the 0:00 profile and the 1:00 dance. A woman and a baby. A thin black strip at the left edge at 0:36 to 0:38.
q7_filmed.why: Home, soft light and a talking face give a native look (H8, F7). The wrap is large in frame from several sides, so each step is readable (F4). The edge strip and the subtitles on the edge of the bottom 35% are small flaws (F1, F2).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00 to 0:02 pink bubble sticker, mid-frame: "DH DR B", then "DH DR BASE -3". 0:03 to 0:57 one word at a time, white bold with a dark outline, centred at about 64% of the frame height: "אז" (0:03), "לכבוד" (0:04), "דאבל" (0:05), "בסיס" (0:09), "לוקחת" (0:40), "וזהו" (0:48), "מוכן" (0:49), "שלום" (0:57). None after 0:58.
q8_text.caption: "שומרות ומנסות???". About 19 words: a save-and-try question, an invitation to a session in Herzliya on 5.10, a tag @michelletheblondie. No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: One-word subtitles, bold with an outline, are readable and timed to the voice (T1, T5), but they are a verbatim transcript for 55 s, not key phrases (T2), at the 64% line on the edge of the bottom 35% (T4). The caption names "ארוג ארוך" but has no hashtags and no tie name (T7).

weak_points: 74 s for one tie, 9 s of it black; one-word subtitles as a full transcript; the first text is unexplained code; two caption asks; a baby's face throughout; no brand or disclosure; jargon narrows the audience.
lumebook_takeaway: Show the finished result first, then the steps in one static phone take with large subtitles above the bottom 35%; cut the tail at the last step; hands only.
not_verified: Whether she sells the wrap or teaches (the caption invites to a session; role not stated); who @michelletheblondie is; the exact spoken words (the machine transcript hears "לחוד השבת" and loops after 58 s, so I read the subtitles); music; the exact cut count (about 9 from the first pass, not counted frame by frame). Correction to src/coded: the sheets show the content ends at 1:04 and the frames from 1:05 to the end are black, about 9 s.
